entities.name: EFAIL
entities.gloss: A security vulnerability affecting email encryption standards and email clients allowing plaintext exfiltration.

entities.name: PGP
entities.gloss: An encryption program and standard providing cryptographic privacy and authentication for data communication.

entities.name: S/MIME
entities.gloss: A standard for public key encryption and signing of MIME data in electronic mail.

entities.name: Apple Mail
entities.gloss: An email client developed by Apple Inc. included with macOS and iOS.

entities.name: iOS Mail
entities.gloss: The default email application built into Apple's iOS mobile operating system.

entities.name: Mozilla Thunderbird
entities.gloss: A free, open-source, cross-platform email client developed by Mozilla.

entities.name: OpenPGP
entities.gloss: An open standard for encrypting and signing emails and files based on PGP.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17688
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in OpenPGP implementation related to CFB gadget attacks enabling plaintext extraction.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17689
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in S/MIME specification related to CBC gadget attacks enabling plaintext extraction.

entities.name: https://efail.de/
entities.gloss: The official website providing details and research materials on the EFAIL vulnerabilities.

entities.name: https://efail.de/efail-attack-paper.pdf
entities.gloss: A research paper detailing the technical aspects of the EFAIL attack.

entities.gloss: A MITRE CVE database entry for vulnerability CVE-2017-17688.

entities.gloss: An Electronic Frontier Foundation article advising users regarding the EFAIL PGP vulnerability.
